## Page or Component
Which page or component does this change affect? (such as Homepage navbar, Footer, or About page team grid)

## Description of the Change
Describe what needs to be changed (such as adjusting font size, fixing layout alignment, changing background color, or adding a hover animation).

## Rationale
Why is this change necessary? (such as improving mobile readability, aligning with brand guidelines, or fixing an alignment bug on large screens)

## Visual References
Attach screenshots, Figma links, or wireframes showing the current look vs. the expected look.

## Responsive Guidelines
How should this change behave on different device screen sizes?
- Mobile (under 768px):
- Tablet (768px - 1024px):
- Desktop (above 1024px):

## Design Specs (if known)
If you have exact values, list them here:
- Colors (HSL, Hex, or CSS variable name):
- Spacing/Paddings:
